description: Compare assembly output and final binary size across GCC optimization levels (-O0, -O1, -O2, -O3, -Os) for embedded ARM targets using S32Compiler GCC (10.2/11.4). Produces realistic size measurements using linked ELF binaries and explains performance vs size trade-offs. Use when the user asks "which optimization level should I use", "compare -O2 vs -Os", or "why is my binary too large".
